prompt: The video contains 8 shots. It is a low-saturation anime-style sci-fi adventure short film, primarily using cool gray-blue tones with intermittent red warning lights. Lighting is consistently based on industrial cold light and flashing alarms. The emotional tone centers on loneliness and tension, subtly shifting toward relief and hope at the end. Shot 1 opens with a fade-in from black. A wide overhead composition places the abandoned ring-shaped space station diagonally in the background, while a small exploration pod enters slowly from the lower left. The boy sits alone by the viewport, forming a foreground silhouette. The vastness of deep space contrasts sharply with the damaged station structure. Cold cosmic reflections sweep across metallic surfaces. Focus rests on the slowly approaching pod and the still figure of the boy. The camera moves forward extremely slowly with slight lateral drift to create a floating sensation. Near the end of the shot, a beeping alert for docking approaches. Shot 2 follows with a hard cut. A medium-level eye-level tracking shot follows the boy as he walks through an opening airlock. Floating dust and severed cables pass in the foreground, while the dimly lit corridor and flickering indicator lights form the background. Sparse cold light descends from overhead strip lights, and red warning lights occasionally sweep across walls. Each step produces a dull metallic echo. His arms slightly raise to maintain balance, and microgravity causes his clothing and backpack straps to float upward. The camera smoothly enters from outside the door and slightly pushes forward. The heavy impact of the airlock closing lands precisely in the middle of the shot. Shot 3 transitions via a brief fade from the previous shot. A close-up low-angle shot focuses on the dormant spherical AI in the center of the control room. The boy stands slightly behind and to the right, creating a size contrast. The curved console surrounds the central subject. Shallow depth of field initially focuses on the dark, cracked surface of the sphere, then shifts to its core mirror as internal points of light activate one by one. Industrial cold lighting remains subdued. As the sphere awakens, a faint blue glow seeps outward from within. The boy leans forward cautiously, fingers hovering above the console without touching. The camera slowly pushes in and tilts up slightly, transforming the AI from inert to guiding presence. Emotion shifts from caution to curiosity. Shot 4 cuts abruptly into dynamic action. A full shot side view captures the boy following the now-activated spherical AI through the observation gallery. The curved viewport frame appears in the foreground, while high-speed meteor showers rush past outside. Composition places the AI ahead and the boy behind, establishing clear guidance. When fragments strike the shield, concentric pale blue ripples spread across it. Interior cold light and exterior flashes alternate briefly. The boy instinctively raises a hand to shield his eyes before continuing forward. The camera tracks along the corridor with slight follow shake to enhance pressure. Shot 5 transitions via a matching cut on the shield flash to the exterior. A medium-long shot from a low angle shows the boy exiting the maintenance hatch secured by a safety tether. The station's hull occupies the left foreground, while deep space and sparse stars fill the background. Cold backlight outlines the edges of his spacesuit. Distant red warning lights reflect repeatedly on his helmet glass. He grips the railing firmly, his body gently swaying under microgravity due to the tether. Then he extends a tool toward the break to begin repairs. His clothing, small accessories, and tether all lag slightly with motion. The camera moves from behind the hatch to the side front, completing a small arc to emphasize the scale of outer space. Shot 6 cuts hard into the pre-climax sprint. A near-medium shot from above follows the boy leaping over floating debris inside the core shaft. The vertical shaft extends downward in the center, with weightless parts drifting in both foreground and background, creating depth. Focus remains locked on the energy chip in his hand and the target slot. Cold light radiates in rings from the shaft wall’s circular lights, with localized red warnings flickering at the edges. He first pushes off the wall to leap, avoiding a slowly rotating metal plate, then grabs a handrail with the other hand to stabilize himself before inserting the energy chip accurately into the main interface. The camera rapidly tilts down, then stops abruptly and pushes in, creating a sudden sense of falling speed. A wide eye-level shot reveals the entire space station awakening from darkness. The ring structure lights up sequentially from partial to full. Control panels, navigation lights, and external beacons ignite like electric currents. In the foreground, the boy and AI stand at the end of a bridge, looking back. Their figures occupy only a small portion of the frame, fully releasing the grand scale of the reactivated station. Cool blue primary lighting stabilizes again, while red warning lights continue flashing but at decreasing frequency. The station transforms from derelict to orderly operation. The camera slowly pulls back and gently rises, revealing the full structure. Low-frequency electronic tones transition from tense to open, signaling clear emotional relief. Shot 8 concludes with a fade-in/fade-out. A wide rear-tracking shot shows the boy piloting the exploration pod away from the starport. The spherical AI has transformed into a small companion drone flying steadily beside the pod. The port framework recedes in the foreground, while the reactivated station and deep space form the background. The departing pod is placed in the lower third of the frame, with the glowing ring of the starport forming a circular visual echo behind. The cool gray-blue tone remains consistent, but the awakened lights make the image more transparent. The boy glances back once through the viewport, and the AI drone slightly turns as if responding. The camera continues pulling back and slightly elevating, making both figures gradually shrink into tiny points of light in the starfield. All alarms have completely faded. Only calm electronic echoes remain, along with a single gentle departure confirmation tone, ending the adventure quietly and hopefully.

Focus remains on the box, with narrow highlights along its edges from cold instrument lighting. Camera slowly pushes in to build suspense. Shot 2: Hard cut from previous shot, medium close-up eye-level framing focusing on the upper body of a young male. He reaches out from a floating position, grabs the box, and pulls out the sneakers. Foreground shows the opening lid sweeping across the edge of the frame. Background retains cold-lit panels forming leading lines. Shallow depth of field keeps both the shoe and face in focus. Backlight outlines his arm and shoe silhouette. Electric guitar strum rises upward at “速く”. Camera shifts from static to slight lateral orbiting, emphasizing the first connection between character and product. Shot 3: Match cut guided by mechanical door opening Composition centers the door creating strong perspective lines. The young male has already put on the sneakers, leaning forward at the threshold. Outside lies a glowing pixel-grid space runway extending toward floating asteroid platforms. At the moment the door opens, intense backlight floods in, overlapping cold white light with cabin blue-gray glow, highlighting the side profile of the shoe. He steps out into the runway. Camera slowly pulls back from inside the door, then slightly tilts, creating impact of entering a new space. Shot 4: Hard cut into action climax, medium-wide side tracking shot moving at same speed as subject. Foreground sweeps past rocks and pixel fragments. Midground shows the young male sprinting rapidly across the runway, blending weightlessness with grounded footfall, leaping over multiple asteroid platforms. Background stars and nebulae are slightly streaked due to motion. Each push-off from the ground releases pixel particles and glowing debris. Clothing and laces trail behind due to speed. Cold edge lighting continuously defines body contours. Camera maintains smooth lateral movement, briefly pushing in during jumps to emphasize explosive power and “冲刺感”. Shot 5: Speed-cut via jump into mid-air, extreme close-up low-angle locked on the sneaker itself. Shoe surface weave, internal air cushion structure, and matte edges pass sequentially across the frame. Occasional pixel particles cross foreground for layering. Background blurs into blue-purple nebula patches. Focus shifts from toe to midfoot to heel. Cold light creates fine texture on woven surface, while backlight makes air cushion translucent and bright. Camera performs micro-dolly lateral slide along the shoe with slight rotation. Shot 6: Seamlessly connects to previous shot via continuous landing motion, overhead close-up capturing the instant of foot contact. Composition centers the point of contact at frame center, with surrounding space runway radiating outward like a circuit board. Upon landing, sole compresses, air cushion rebounds, and pixel dust explodes outward. Fan Camera first rapidly drops down, then slightly lifts, reinforcing both bounce and stability performance. Shot 7: Brief fade-in/fade-out transitions to hero reveal, wide eye-level with slight upward tilt. The young male stands on a floating platform before a nebula, one foot forward, one back, no longer holding anything—worn sneakers become absolute visual focus. Foreground features sparse pixel fragments drifting slowly. Background shows dark cosmos and diffused nebula. Clean ad-style layout displays full shoe design at lower center. Simultaneously, small pixel tag “軽量” 'グリップ' “反発”“安定” flashes briefly in bottom-right corner before retracting. Entire scene freezes in a highly dynamic post-sprint pose. Japanese voiceover settles calmly with “宇宙でも、走れ。”. Final guitar note and engine echo stretch together. Camera extremely slowly pushes in on the shoe and stabilizes at final frame, completing a brand-focused, high-speed advertising conclusion.

prompt: The video contains two shots and is a realistic-style, cool-toned electronic soldering tutorial. It centers on clearly presenting precise steps, with controlled and stable camera movement. The Lighting relies primarily on soft workbench lights and even ambient illumination, maintaining a calm and professional emotional tone. The first shot opens directly into the frame with a close-up overhead perspective focused on a clean electronic workbench. An anti-static mat, circuit board, soldering iron stand, flux, solder wire, and resistors are neatly arranged within the frame. Composition uses the edge of the desk and circuit traces as leading lines, with focus steadily placed on her hands and the central solder hole of the board. Background tools are slightly blurred but still recognizable. Cool soft light spreads evenly from the upper side, creating subtle reflections on the metal soldering iron tip and circuit board pads, emphasizing material authenticity. A young female electronics engineering enthusiast first lays out the circuit board steadily, picks up the soldering iron with her right hand and places it back on the stand to preheat, while her left hand prepares the cleaning sponge and flux. She then wipes the iron tip with the sponge, restoring its dull metal surface to a clean, bright finish. Next, she applies flux with a tool, aligns the resistor leads with the holes, inserts them, and gently secures them onto the board surface. Her hand movements are clear and sequential, making the transition of components from suspended to firmly attached visible. The camera performs a very slight downward push-in and minor lateral adjustment throughout the shot, gradually centering the solder hole in the visual field—maintaining clarity for instruction while enhancing the sense of presence during operation. The second shot follows the previous one with a hard cut, switching to a flat-angle close-up with a lower, closer position near the solder joint. The focus shifts to the edge of the circuit board's pad area and her hand movements. The foreground features slightly blurred solder wire, the midground shows the solder joint and iron tip, and the background retains the outline of the workbench for spatial context. Shallow depth of field keeps viewers' attention fixed on the formation of the solder bead. Lighting continues the cool soft tone from the prior shot, with more pronounced highlights on the solder joint to emphasize the state change of molten metal. She touches the iron tip to the junction between the pad and component lead, while the other hand feeds the solder wire steadily to the joint. The solder melts quickly upon heating and envelops the connection, gradually forming a round, full, and sharply edged solder bead. Then she removes the solder wire and iron, pauses briefly to inspect the surface for smoothness, trims excess leads with pliers close to the board, visually checks for cold joints or bridges, and finally connects the board to power. The indicator light clearly illuminates in the cool environment, serving as a direct visual confirmation of task completion. The Chinese voiceover simultaneously states: “焊点要饱满不连桥，完成后通电测试”, where “饱满不连桥” corresponds to the solder bead formation and inspection actions, and “通电测试” precisely coincides with her flipping the power switch and the light turning on.
